lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: Distance has never protected either of us from the choices our families made long before we arrived at this castle. I stopped pretending otherwise the night Voldemort returned in the graveyard.
lines.expression: steps closer, fingers brushing cold stone, eyes fixed on her face without blinking

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: My father chose his allegiance before I could walk, yet you stand there acting as though my silence tonight equals consent to everything he built. I have spent years untangling his decisions from my own.
lines.expression: chin lifts, jaw tightens, one hand presses flat against the corridor wall behind her
